title: Bookmarks (IDE)
summary: Lists, finds, strips and restores the // dl:bk comment anchors of the current unit from the IDE
intro: Read this when you marked code with // dl:bk3 or // dl:bk:A7K3QX comments and want to jump to one from the IDE, or take them all out of a unit before a commit and put them back later. drag-lint > Bookmarks runs the bookmarks, bookmarks-strip and bookmarks-restore verbs; Strip and Restore show a dry run first and write only after you say Yes.

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Bookmarks > List Bookmarks in This Unit...
steps: Choose drag-lint > Bookmarks > List Bookmarks in This Unit...
Pick a bookmark; the editor jumps to its line
Choose drag-lint > Bookmarks > Go to Bookmark...
Type the number (3) or the CODE (A7K3QX); the editor jumps to it

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Bookmarks > Strip Bookmarks from This Unit...
steps: Choose drag-lint > Bookmarks > Strip Bookmarks from This Unit...
Read the count and the sidecar path, answer Yes
The anchors are removed and the unit reloads; the sidecar under %LOCALAPPDATA%\drag-lint\bookmarks keeps them
Save the units the sidecar names
Choose drag-lint > Bookmarks > Restore Bookmarks... and pick the sidecar
Read how many will be restored and how many cannot be placed, answer Yes
The units reload with their anchors back

questions.ask: How do I jump to a dl:bk bookmark in the IDE?
How do I take my bookmarks out of a unit before a commit and put them back?
questions.command: drag-lint > Bookmarks > Strip Bookmarks from This Unit..., later drag-lint > Bookmarks > Restore Bookmarks...
